description: Rate- and state-dependent friction joint model (laboratory rate-state friction law), available via 'block contact jmodel assign ratestate'.

property_groups.name: Properties
property_groups.description: Joint properties for the 'ratestate' joint constitutive model. Assign the model with 'block contact jmodel assign ratestate [range ...]', then set these with 'block contact property <keyword> <value> [range jmodel ratestate]'. Property table completed 2026-08-14 from live enumeration (this file previously documented only the two stiffnesses; the model has NO official 9.7 property page - names are live ground truth, per-property semantics mostly uncurated).

properties.description: Rate-and-state friction direct-effect parameter a. Live-enumerated; no official 9.7 property page.
Rate-and-state friction evolution parameter b. Live-enumerated.
Reference friction coefficient at the reference velocity. Live-enumerated.
Selects the state evolution law. Live-enumerated; accepted values uncurated.
Maximum multiplier bound. Live-enumerated; semantics uncurated.
Minimum multiplier bound. Live-enumerated; semantics uncurated.
Shear displacement at which the joint ceases to dilate.

note: Detailed property documentation is not present in the local 9.0 manual; only the universal joint stiffness terms are listed. Use 'block contact property' against the running engine for the full rate-state parameter set.
usage: block contact jmodel assign ratestate ; block contact property <prop> <value> [range jmodel ratestate]
verification: Live-verified 2026-08-14 on 3DEC 9.7.47: property set enumerated via the wrong-property-name error after 'block contact jmodel assign' (exact match with this file unless noted). NOT in 3DEC 7.00: 'block contact jmodel assign ratestate' is rejected; the model-name error enumeration lists only the seven 7.0 jmodels (elastic, mohr, bilinear-mohr, softening-mohr, cyjm, nonlinear, power).
